0022600178.text: Memphis hosts Indiana in the Grizzlies' eighth game of the 2026-27 season, and they come in at 6-1, 2-1 at home and 4-0 on the road, sitting 2nd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back, and 2nd in the West after a one-game losing streak. The Pacers are 2-6, 0-4 at home and on a five-game losing streak, sitting 3rd in the Central, 4.5 games back, and 12th in the East. There have been no meetings yet in 2026-27, and Memphis won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, most recently 125-106 in Indianapolis on March 1, 2026. Memphis is missing Scotty Pippen Jr. (out, back soreness) and Quinten Post (day-to-day, game-time decision, ankle), while Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Obi Toppin (coach's decision, soreness), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), with Aaron Nesmith, Andrew Nembhard, Kelly Oubre Jr., Larry Nance Jr., and Pascal Siakam listed as day-to-day game-time decisions.
